title: Arunachal flash flood: Indian Air Force launches rescue operations in flood-hit Keyi Panyor
summary: IAF airlifted SDRF personnel and relief materials to flood-affected Pitapool, overcoming challenging weather. Authorities are continuing air support operations as rescues unfold, while restoration of road connectivity proceeds despite landslide-blocked routes in six districts due to heavy rainfall.
